Claim 2 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 further comprising: displaying the filtered EPG information on a display device coupled to a subscriber's receiver.

Claim 3 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein filtering comprises: obtaining channel accessibility of the subscriber based on subscription tier information; and removing EPG information related to a channel that is not within the channel accessibility of the subscriber.

Claim 4 (Currently amended): The method of claim 3 wherein obtaining comprises: retrieving channel subscription information of the subscriber from the content delivery provider that specifies authorized channels; and creating a list of subscriber's channel identifiers of channels accessible to the subscriber from the channel subscription information.

Claim 5 (Currently amended): The method of claim 3 wherein removing comprises: reading the EPG information received from the EPG provider; extracting a channel identifier from the EPG information; and removing the EPG information corresponding to the extracted channel identifier if the extracted channel identifier does not belong to the list of the subscriber's channel identifiers.

Claim 6 (Original): The method of claim 1 wherein the programs are delivered by one of a television network, a cable operator, a direct satellite program provider, a digital cable content provider, and a network content provider.

Claim 7 (Currently amended): An article of manufacture comprising: a machine-accessible medium including data that, when accessed by a machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: retrieving electronic program guide (EPG) information from an EPG provider that is separate from a content delivery provider; and filtering the EPG information to retain program information related to programs delivered by the content delivery provider to a subscriber, the content delivery provider being different from the EPG provider.

Claim 8 (Currently amended): The article of manufacture of claim 7 wherein the data further comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: displaying the filtered EPG information on a display device coupled to a subscriber's receiver.

Claim 9 (Currently amended): The article of manufacture of claim 7 wherein the data causing the machine to perform filtering comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: obtaining channel accessibility of the subscriber based on subscription tier information; and removing EPG information related to a channel that is not within the channel accessibility of the subscriber.

Claim 10 (Currently amended): The article of manufacture of claim 9 wherein the data causing the machine to perform obtaining comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: retrieving channel subscription information of the subscriber from the content delivery provider that specifies authorized channels; and creating a list of subscriber's channel identifiers of channels accessible to the subscriber from the channel subscription information.

Claim 11 (Currently amended): The article of manufacture of claim 9 wherein the data causing the machine to perform removing comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: reading the EPG information received from the EPG provider; extracting a channel identifier from the EPG information; and removing the EPG information corresponding to the extracted channel identifier if the extracted channel identifier does not belong to the list of the subscriber's channel identifiers.

Claim 14 (Currently amended): The program guide module of claim 13 wherein the enhanced EPG module further comprises: a module to display the filtered EPG information on a display device coupled to a subscriber's receiver.
